1	import {
2	  pgTable,
3	  uuid,
4	  text,
5	  integer,
6	  timestamp,
7	  jsonb,
8	  index,
9	  uniqueIndex,
10	} from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
11	import { plugins } from "./plugins.js";
12	import type { PluginJobStatus, PluginJobRunStatus, PluginJobRunTrigger } from "@paperclipai/shared";
13	
14	/**
15	 * `plugin_jobs` table — registration and runtime configuration for
16	 * scheduled jobs declared by plugins in their manifests.
17	 *
18	 * Each row represents one scheduled job entry for a plugin. The
19	 * `job_key` matches the key declared in the manifest's `jobs` array.
20	 * The `schedule` column stores the cron expression or interval string
21	 * used by the job scheduler to decide when to fire the job.
22	 *
23	 * Status values:
24	 * - `active` — job is enabled and will run on schedule
25	 * - `paused` — job is temporarily disabled by the operator
26	 * - `error` — job has been disabled due to repeated failures
27	 *
28	 * @see PLUGIN_SPEC.md §21.3 — `plugin_jobs`
29	 */
30	export const pluginJobs = pgTable(
31	  "plugin_jobs",
32	  {
33	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
34	    /** FK to the owning plugin. Cascades on delete. */
35	    pluginId: uuid("plugin_id")
36	      .notNull()
37	      .references(() => plugins.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
38	    /** Identifier matching the key in the plugin manifest's `jobs` array. */
39	    jobKey: text("job_key").notNull(),
40	    /** Cron expression (e.g. `"0 * * * *"`) or interval string. */
41	    schedule: text("schedule").notNull(),
42	    /** Current scheduling state. */
43	    status: text("status").$type<PluginJobStatus>().notNull().default("active"),
44	    /** Timestamp of the most recent successful execution. */
45	    lastRunAt: timestamp("last_run_at", { withTimezone: true }),
46	    /** Pre-computed timestamp of the next scheduled execution. */
47	    nextRunAt: timestamp("next_run_at", { withTimezone: true }),
48	    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
49	    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
50	  },
51	  (table) => ({
52	    pluginIdx: index("plugin_jobs_plugin_idx").on(table.pluginId),
53	    nextRunIdx: index("plugin_jobs_next_run_idx").on(table.nextRunAt),
54	    uniqueJobIdx: uniqueIndex("plugin_jobs_unique_idx").on(table.pluginId, table.jobKey),
55	  }),
56	);
57	
58	/**
59	 * `plugin_job_runs` table — immutable execution history for plugin-owned jobs.
60	 *
61	 * Each row is created when a job run begins and updated when it completes.
62	 * Rows are never modified after `status` reaches a terminal value
63	 * (`succeeded` | `failed` | `cancelled`).
64	 *
65	 * Trigger values:
66	 * - `scheduled` — fired automatically by the cron/interval scheduler
67	 * - `manual` — triggered by an operator via the admin UI or API
68	 *
69	 * @see PLUGIN_SPEC.md §21.3 — `plugin_job_runs`
70	 */
71	export const pluginJobRuns = pgTable(
72	  "plugin_job_runs",
73	  {
74	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
75	    /** FK to the parent job definition. Cascades on delete. */
76	    jobId: uuid("job_id")
77	      .notNull()
78	      .references(() => pluginJobs.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
79	    /** Denormalized FK to the owning plugin for efficient querying. Cascades on delete. */
80	    pluginId: uuid("plugin_id")
81	      .notNull()
82	      .references(() => plugins.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
83	    /** What caused this run to start (`"scheduled"` or `"manual"`). */
84	    trigger: text("trigger").$type<PluginJobRunTrigger>().notNull(),
85	    /** Current lifecycle state of this run. */
86	    status: text("status").$type<PluginJobRunStatus>().notNull().default("pending"),
87	    /** Wall-clock duration in milliseconds. Null until the run finishes. */
88	    durationMs: integer("duration_ms"),
89	    /** Error message if `status === "failed"`. */
90	    error: text("error"),
91	    /** Ordered list of log lines emitted during this run. */
92	    logs: jsonb("logs").$type<string[]>().notNull().default([]),
93	    startedAt: timestamp("started_at", { withTimezone: true }),
94	    finishedAt: timestamp("finished_at", { withTimezone: true }),
95	    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
96	  },
97	  (table) => ({
98	    jobIdx: index("plugin_job_runs_job_idx").on(table.jobId),
99	    pluginIdx: index("plugin_job_runs_plugin_idx").on(table.pluginId),
100	    statusIdx: index("plugin_job_runs_status_idx").on(table.status),
101	  }),
102	);
